title: Without QuickBooks connected, nothing is sent and terms work the same
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop is not connected to QuickBooks and invoices a customer on a term of its own.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The test organization is not connected to QuickBooks.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds the shop's own term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, and work order {Work-order-1} for it is complete.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S8-10 Customer, {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S8-10 Fourteen and {Work-order-1} is S2-15446.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. On {Work-order-1}'s Finance tab, set Invoice Date to Oct 5, 2026.
  2. Click Create Invoice.
  3. Open the QB Unexported report.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Due date reads Oct 19, 2026.
  • Step 2: the invoice is created with no QuickBooks message.
  • Step 3: the report holds nothing for this invoice (nothing was sent).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11677 (Story 8, QuickBooks sync - credit terms)

  • S8-N1: “If the QuickBooks integration is not connected, nothing is sent and Story 3: Create or edit a credit term, Story 4: Move Customers, Story 5: New Customer and Edit Customer and Story 7: Due dates behave exactly as they do without the integration.”
